zh.headline: Zuckerberg 内部表态：AI Agent 进展不及预期
zh.observation: 今天的简报释放了一个清晰信号：**AI Agent 生态正在经历从"能做"到"做好"的关键跃迁**。一方面，Zuckerberg 承认 Agent 进展不及预期、OpenAI 联合创始人认为插件失败是因为模型未成熟——这些来自行业领袖的坦诚表态说明 Agent 落地比预想更难。另一方面，美团 1.6T 开源模型、Anthropic Claude Science、NVIDIA HORIZON 等重大发布表明，模型能力和应用场景仍在快速扩展。最值得关注的是"技能生态"的爆发：从 Claude Code 的 337 个技能到 Facebook 的 Agent 就绪设计系统，再到 dotnet 官方技能库，Agent 正在从单一工具演变为平台生态。对于 AI builder 而言，当前的关键不是追逐最新模型，而是理解 Agent 在模糊查询、长期记忆、成本优化等方面的真实瓶颈。

en.headline: Zuckerberg tells staff: AI agents haven't progressed as quickly as hoped
en.observation: Today's brief sends a clear signal: **the AI agent ecosystem is undergoing a critical transition from "can it work" to "does it work well."** On one hand, Zuckerberg's admission that agents haven't progressed as hoped and OpenAI's co-founder acknowledging plugin failures due to model immaturity—these candid assessments from industry leaders show agent deployment is harder than anticipated. On the other hand, major releases like Meituan's 1.6T open-source model, Anthropic's Claude Science, and NVIDIA's HORIZON demonstrate that model capabilities and application scenarios continue expanding rapidly. Most notably, the explosion of "skill ecosystems"—from 337 Claude Code skills to Facebook's agent-ready design system to dotnet's official skill library—signals agents evolving from single tools into platform ecosystems. For AI builders, the key today isn't chasing the latest model, but understanding the real bottlenecks in ambiguous queries, long-term memory, and cost optimization.
